To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

stochastic modeling and optimization can provide a systematic approach for efficient planning, operation and optimal control of a microgrid, and that the stochastic modeling and stochastic optimization tools are essential in the planning, control and operation of a smart microgrid, in order to deal with the randomness in renewable energy sources, the buffering effect in energy storage devices and PEVs with vehicle-to-grid system, and the high mobility in PEVs.
stochastic modeling and optimization are essential in microgrid operation and control, and the future smart grid will be an interconnected network consisting of many self-contained microgrides.
stochastic modeling and optimization are the most promising tools for microgrids, and they can be used for planning, operation and controlling of a microgrid.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the stochastic modeling and control of a microgrid with PEV charging and discharging, energy storage and renewable energy sources, such as solar and wind power generation.
the stochastic modeling and analysis of a microgrid and its stochastic optimization for efficient, reliable, and economic operation.
the stochastic planning and operation of microgrids in the future smart grid, which is expected to be a highly distributed, highly interconnected and highly intelligent system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
stochastic modeling and optimization techniques have the potential to be a powerful tool in the planning, design and operation of microgrids.
the microgrid is a promising and important research area for future smart grids.
the stochastic modeling and the stochastic optimization are two powerful and complementary tools to address the technical challenges in microgrids, which are the main focus of this survey.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
stochastic modeling and optimization can provide efficient solutions for the planning, operation, and control of microgrid.

, in order to better adopt the intermittent renewable power generation and the buffering effect of the energy storage devices in a microgrid, the following two key issues must be addressed: (1) the modeling of the stochastic nature of the renewable power generation and energy storage devices; and (2) the optimization of the planning and operation of microgrids.
stochastic modeling and optimization can be used to solve the planning, operation, and control problems for a microgrid in the smart grid.
The main takeaway from our work is that

stochastic modeling and optimization are essential to the planning, operation, control and market operation in a microgrid, and the stochastic modeling and stochastic optimization tools are expected to play an even more important role in a microgrid with high penetration of renewable power generation, storage devices and PEVs.
stochastic optimization tools can be applied to microgrid problems, but the challenges and limitations of the existing stochastic optimization methods for microgrids are not well understood.

, by considering the randomness and the high mobility in microgrids, stochastic optimization can be used to design optimal control strategies, to improve the reliability and to reduce the cost for the operation of a microgrid.
